transcript.text: Ma'am, here's the tasking information I mentioned. V-11 has a confirmed 0600-1000 inspection and support movement the day after tomorrow, and it must have all four replacement tires installed before that task. I received the signed tasking from the operations cell this morning, but it hasn't been posted to the maintenance board yet. Given that we can start at 0700 tomorrow and each replacement takes four hours, V-11 would be done by 1100 tomorrow if we prioritize it first. I'm recommending V-11 go to the top of the priority order.

transcript.text: Thank you both for bringing this forward. This is exactly why I wanted these updates before finalizing the order. Here's what I'm seeing: We have eight tires on hand, enough for two vehicles. V-11 has a hard requirement — all four tires installed before a 0600-1000 task the day after tomorrow. If we start V-11 first at 0700 tomorrow, it's done by 1100, well within the window. Lt. Farouk, your update on V-14 changes things significantly. If four tires for V-14 arrive by 1600 tomorrow, we should not spend our on-hand tires on V-14. That means V-11 goes first, and V-19 goes second with the remaining four on-hand tires. V-14 gets deferred until its shipment arrives at 1600 tomorrow, and maintenance can begin on V-14 after V-19 is complete. SFC Morgan, does that timeline work? Lt. Farouk, do you have any concerns with that approach?
